preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 50.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= HomeTeamGoals <= 100 and 0 <= AwayTeamGoals <= 100 for HomeTeamGoals, AwayTeamGoals in zip(home_goals, away_goals))
preconditions.description: Number of goals scored by each team is between 0 and 100.
Length of the name of each team does not exceed 10.
Name of each team contains only lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: Output contains exactly two space-separated strings.

postconditions.expression: return_value.split()[0] in team_names and return_value.split()[1] in team_names
postconditions.description: The two strings in the output are valid team names.
The two strings in the output are different.

postconditions.expression: points[return_value.split()[0]] > points[return_value.split()[1]] or (points[return_value.split()[0]] == points[return_value.split()[1]] and goal_diff[return_value.split()[0]] > goal_diff[return_value.split()[1]])
postconditions.description: The first team has more points than the second team, or they have the same points but the first team has a higher goal difference.
